in_marathi.name: Girik
in_marathi.long_meaning: Girik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Giri' which means mountain and 'Ka' meaning warrior. The name Girik is believed to be associated with the brave mountain warriors in Hindu mythology.

vedic_reference.note: The name 'Girik' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Giri' which means 'hill' or 'mountain'. It is also a name for Lord Shiva, who is often depicted as residing on mountains. This name is a beautiful choice for a child born in the mountains or for someone who aspires to reach great heights in life.
